tickerText: [TENNIS] Rolex Shanghai Masters Day 6: Carlos Alcaraz faces Juan Manuel Cerundolo not before 18:00 after Auger-Aliassime–Carabelli and Bu–Ruud, while Daniil Medvedev opens against Jan-Lennard Struff and Taylor Fritz meets Matteo Arnaldi • [SQUASH] CIB Egyptian Squash Open main draw begins Saturday at O West—Round One across four courts after qualifying crowned Seif Refaay and Habiba Hani before Pyramids quarterfinals Oct. 13–14 • [BADMINTON] Arctic Open semifinals in Vantaa: Lee Zii Jia meets Anders Antonsen and Ratchanok Intanon faces Line Christophersen as the Super 500 sets Sunday finals • [PICKLEBALL] Veolia Chicago Cup pro semifinals Saturday at Life Time Northbrook from noon CT on PickleballTV and Tennis Channel after Friday's quarterfinal slate • [TABLE TENNIS] WTT China Smash penultimate day in Beijing: Wang Manyu vs Miyu Haruka and Chen Xingtong vs Tomoka Sato in women's singles semis plus men's doubles and women's doubles finals

newsItems.title: Wang Manyu Into China Semis
newsItems.excerpt: Top seed Wang Manyu swept Shin Yu-bin 4-0 in Beijing and faces Miyu Haruka on Oct. 10, while Chen Xingtong meets Tomoka Sato and the women's doubles final caps a busy penultimate day.

newsItems.title: Chicago Cup Hits Semifinals
newsItems.excerpt: The Veolia Chicago Cup moves into pro semifinals Saturday at Life Time Northbrook with gates at noon CT, streaming on PickleballTV and Tennis Channel after Friday's quarterfinals.

newsItems.title: Alcaraz Leads Shanghai Day 6
newsItems.excerpt: Round-of-64 Saturday at the Rolex Shanghai Masters features Carlos Alcaraz against Juan Manuel Cerundolo not before 18:00, plus Medvedev–Struff and Fritz–Arnaldi on the outer courts.

newsItems.title: Lee Reaches Arctic Semifinals
newsItems.excerpt: Lee Zii Jia ousted Christo Popov in straight games at the BWF Super 500 in Vantaa and meets Anders Antonsen on Oct. 10, while Ratchanok Intanon advanced past PV Sindhu in three.
